items.why: The AI selloff is spreading from Wall Street, with a massive tech sell-off wiping $2.5 trillion from the market and chip stocks caught in the slide.
Nvidia stock is down 40% from its high, and the post earnings slide keeps dragging the chip sector lower even as Barron's notes there is hope.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Stocks are plunging as investors take cover amid growing uncertainty, pushing the fear gauge higher.

market_note: Futures are lower, with Nasdaq futures down 2.27% and S&P futures down 0.99%, while Dow futures are up 0.26%.
summary: Stocks are sliding again as the AI selloff spreads, with the S&P 500 set for its longest losing run since 2020 and Anthropic shares falling after their IPO debut. The Nasdaq is leading the drop while the Dow holds up.
